title: How Leaving His Phone in Another Room Changed What a Godly Man Reaches For First
caption:
A godly man's phone lives in another room now.

The first ten minutes stopped belonging to the feed. The itch didn't disappear, it just lost its remote. And his hand started reaching for the Word instead of the wall.

Whoever you feed first wins the day.

You can't fight an empty hand. Fill it before the feed does.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #digitaldetox
